resources.string: Keeps the Server field. Port, keys, TLS and other settings are updated from the subscription. Disabling this restores the subscription address on the next update.
Available for VLESS and Trojan with HTTP transports and the compatible Xray core.
This transport cannot use the ordinary Cloudflare CDN. Supported: WebSocket, gRPC, HTTPUpgrade and XHTTP over TLS.
This XHTTP/TLS profile uses HTTP/3 because ALPN contains only h3. The current IP finder tests TCP connections only. The profile settings have not been changed.
TLS is required. Reality and plain TCP/UDP profiles cannot use this search.
The profile port is not a supported Cloudflare HTTPS port. It will not be changed automatically.
Specify a domain for TLS SNI. A numeric address cannot identify the original CDN website.
Native transport overrides, ECH, masks or flow in this profile require a separate search adapter. This configuration will not be changed silently.
The separate XHTTP download channel needs explicit address, port, TLS serverName and HTTP host, without nested downloads or custom socket settings.
The profile configuration is incomplete or invalid.
For a large batch, disable quick search and increase the time limit. The list shows up to 256 best results; up to 256 working IPs are saved for selection.
Stop after finding the target number of working addresses. Each passes profile checks and a fresh connection.
Check the entire batch within the time limit. Repeat checks for the three best addresses with fresh connections.
The target number of working addresses was found and saved. Select an IP from the results.
Time limit reached. Confirmed addresses were saved; the rest can be checked in another search.
Check the values and ranges above.
Checking addresses again with fresh connections…
The network changed. Search stopped and current results were cleared. Start again on the new network.
The profile changed. Reopen this screen before searching or selecting an address.
Enter numeric IP addresses only, no more than the search limit.
One of the supplied IPs is outside the Cloudflare ranges.
This network has no global IPv6 address. Remove the supplied IPv6 candidates.
No address passed every HTTPS check. This does not prove that the server is down; verify CDN compatibility and try another batch.
Search finished. Select a working address from the results.
Search stopped. The best confirmed addresses were saved in the results list.
Address saved in this profile. Reconnect an active tunnel to use it.
Search could not finish. Profile settings were preserved.
Save the profile changes before searching for Cloudflare IPs.
Only the address is kept. Keys, port and other settings update from the subscription.
TLS name and HTTP settings stay unchanged. Retest saved addresses when changing networks.
Up to 256 of the best working IPs are saved, including earlier searches. Tap an address to apply it.
Unavailable for testing. Remove it from the group.
More checks increase load on the device and network.
